items.headline: MLB sues players' union, asking court to declare lockout legal
items.description: Major League Baseball sued its players' association in federal court Wednesday, asking that the league's contemplated lockout next week be declared legal.

items.headline: Free agent Alec Bohm reaches 2-year deal with Royals, reports say
items.description: Free agent third baseman Alec Bohm has agreed to a two-year deal with Kansas City, according to multiple reports.

items.headline: Paul Goldschmidt says time with Yankees prepared him for expectations Mets face
items.description: Paul Goldschmidt knew Mets manager Andy Green from their time together with Arizona in 2015 and was eager make the move across town from the Yankees to reunite.

items.headline: Newcastle owners not considering full sale, only minority deals - reports
items.description: Newcastle's Saudi owners are not treating the possibility of selling a minority stake in the club as the first step towards a full sale, the Press Association understands.

items.headline: Superlatives for this MLB free agent class, from Lowe to Gausman
items.description: Next best move for Mets? Best free agency timing? We have a yearbook's worth of awards for the top MLB free agents.

items.headline: Ripple effects of Tarik Skubal signing on Mets, Dodgers and more
items.description: The impact of the record deal for MLB's top free agent extends past his new team to the top suitors who missed out on him.

items.headline: Sources: Reds catcher Tyler Stephenson staying on 3-year, $30 million deal
items.description: The Reds are retaining catcher Tyler Stephenson on a three-year agreement worth $30 million, sources told ESPN.

items.headline: Sources: White Sox, OF Tyrone Taylor agree to 2-year, $17 million deal
items.description: Tyrone Taylor, who had a monster second half last season, fills a hole in the White Sox's outfield.

items.headline: Scott Servais joins Rockies as senior director of baseball operations
items.description: The Rockies brought in former Seattle manager Scott Servais on Tuesday as senior director of baseball operations.

items.headline: MLB drops contract escrow provision in salary cap proposal
items.description: MLB dropped its demand for an escrow provision in its salary cap proposal, instead saying that an overage or underpayment would be accounted for in future seasons.

items.headline: Sources: Japanese righty Kaima Taira, Blue Jays agree to 5-year, $80M deal
items.description: Right-hander Kaima Taira and the Blue Jays have agreed to a five-year, $80 million deal with an opt-out after the third season, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan.
